note: Canonical domain-code dictionary. The code is a short, human-friendly NAMESPACE SHARD used in IDs (SQ-<CODE>-NNNNNN for questions, SCR-<CODE>-NNNNNN for claims). The AUTHORITATIVE disease identity is the cross-reference (MONDO / ICD-11 / MeSH) — the code itself carries no clinical meaning, so we never re-typecast it. Rules: code = 2-4 uppercase letters; unique; STABLE; NEVER reused or repurposed (a wrong/merged domain is deprecated, not recycled). status: active = has questions/claims; proposed = reserved/referenced; deprecated = retired (kept as tombstone).
